shots.visual_description: A close-up shot of a young Asian woman (20-30s) gently touching her cheek after washing her face. Her brow is slightly furrowed, conveying a subtle feeling of discomfort and tightness. Her skin appears slightly dry. Soft, diffused natural light from a bathroom window. Static camera, shallow depth of field focusing on her face. Lifestyle, commercial quality, 4K.

A medium shot of the same young Asian woman looking into a bathroom mirror, her expression still slightly troubled. She gently rubs her cheeks, perhaps noticing a subtle redness or flakiness. The bathroom is clean and modern, lit with soft, warm studio lighting. Static camera, eye-level. Lifestyle, commercial quality, 4K.
shots.narration: 清洁完皮肤就喊渴，甚至泛红？

shots.visual_description: A dynamic split-screen showing two contrasting scenes. Left side: A stylized animation of water droplets quickly evaporating from taut skin, representing dryness after strong cleansing, rendered in cool tones. Right side: A gentle, foamy cleanse with minimal visual effect, appearing ineffective, rendered in soft, muted tones. A large, animated glowing question mark bursts onto the screen in the center, challenging the visuals. Bright, energetic studio lighting. Static camera. Dynamic, infographic style, 4K.
shots.narration: 清洁力强就干燥？温和就洗不净？

shots.visual_description: An elegant product showcase shot of the 'Hyaluronic Acid Cleanser' bottle, matching the product_reference description. The sleek, modern bottle stands upright on a minimalist, pristine white surface with subtle ripples of water reflecting its hydrating properties. Gentle water droplets bead on the bottle's surface. Soft, high-key studio lighting with a subtle glow. The camera slowly zooms in on the product, highlighting the 'Hyaluronic Acid' label and its premium texture. Commercial quality, 4K.
shots.narration: 答案揭晓！玻尿酸洗面奶，水润净肤新体验！

selling_points: 洁面后水润不紧绷：告别传统洁面后的干燥紧绷感，真实用户对比验证洗后肌肤水润舒适
玻尿酸专业认证：皮肤科医生与美妆博主科普成分功效，趣味小实验验证温和与高保湿力
清洁温和一步到位：满足消费者对清洁力与温和保湿的双重需求，日常洁面带来舒适体验

selling_point_coverage: 痛点共鸣（洗后紧绷）已覆盖
质疑传统观念（清洁≠干燥）已覆盖
引入解决方案（玻尿酸洗面奶）已覆盖

winning_patterns: 真实用户使用前后对比（尤其强调洁面后肌肤水润不紧绷）
专业人士（如皮肤科医生、美妆博主）科普玻尿酸成分及产品功效
日常生活场景融入，展示洁面步骤及产品带来的舒适体验
趣味小实验（如PH值测试、水分测试）证明产品温和与保湿力
hook_strategies: 直接提问用户痛点（如“你还在忍受洗完脸的紧绷感吗？”）
揭露行业“秘密”或误区（如“洗面奶不仅仅是清洁！”）
制造悬念，通过特写产品或局部肌肤状态吸引注意
展示惊人效果（如瞬间水润光泽的脸部特写）
content_structures: 问题提出-产品介绍-功效演示-用户反馈-行动号召
成分科普-使用教学-场景应用-情感共鸣-限时优惠
emotional_triggers: 对干燥、紧绷、刺激等肌肤问题的恐惧
对水润、光滑、健康肌肤的渴望和自信
追求温和、安心、高效护肤的心理需求

market_summary.summary: 消费者普遍追求清洁力与温和保湿兼具的洁面产品。市面上洗面奶同质化严重，用户痛点在于清洁后肌肤干燥紧绷，以及对产品成分安全性和功效的质疑。
key_findings: 用户对洗面奶的“洗净力”和“洗后不紧绷”有双重高要求。
玻尿酸作为明星保湿成分，能有效提升产品在消费者心中的“保湿”认知。
敏感肌用户对洁面产品的温和性、无刺激性有强烈需求。
成分党崛起，消费者越来越关注产品成分列表和功效原理。
